verses.1: Let those who have power over you judge others according to their wrongdoings, and not according to their virtues.
verses.2: Do you not know that the holy ones judge the world? And if the world is indeed judged by you, then you are worthy of the most accurate criteria for judging it.
verses.3: Don’t you know that we use messengers, rather than living beings?
verses.4: So, if you have any criteria for judging, those who are superior in the church, then you sit with them.
verses.5: I say this to your confusion. In fact, there is not a single wise person among you who can distinguish between his brother and himself.
verses.6: But a brother is judged by another brother, and this is something that cannot be believed.
verses.7: Now, it’s obvious that you deserve punishment for what you’ve done. Why then don’t you suffer even more? Why don’t you be punished even more?
verses.8: But you yourselves are unjust and cruel. And this is what happens to brothers.
verses.9: And do you not know that they will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived. Neither are they lovers of prostitutes, nor worshippers of idols, nor adulterers, nor fools, nor men who act in a shameful manner.
verses.10: They neither steal nor exploit others. They are not drunkards, nor do they take things by force. They will not take away the kingdom that belongs to God.
verses.11: And sometimes it was like this: But you were accepted, honored, and truly worthy in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the spirit of our God.
verses.12: It’s always acceptable to me. But not always is it appropriate. It’s always acceptable to me. But I won’t allow myself to be controlled by anyone.
verses.13: The poisons in the body, and the body itself is affected by those poisons. But God will destroy both these things. The body belongs not to the whore, but to the Lord; and the Lord belongs to the body.
verses.14: But the God and Lord also raised us up, and He filled us with His power.
verses.15: Don’t you know that the members of your bodies are actually parts of Christ? So, do you really think that the parts of Christ can be turned into instruments of prostitution? No, that’s not possible.
verses.16: Don’t you know that a man who is attached to a prostitute is actually a slave? They say that both of them become one body.
verses.17: And that which clings to the lord is a kind of “spirit”.
verses.18: Forgive the act of prostitution. Every sin that a person commits from within their own body is a sin. But those who engage in prostitution for personal gain commit a sin.
verses.19: Do you not know that your bodies are the temple of the holy spirit within you? You possess this spirit from God. And it is not your own.
verses.20: For you were honored with respect; you glorified the God in your own bodies.
